question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Fatigued
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Fatigued"** means feeling extremely tired or exhausted, often due to physical or mental exertion. (थका हुआ)

 
 
• **Example: **After running the marathon, she felt completely** fatigued** and could barely stand.
 
 
 
• **"Jaded" **refers to feeling tired, bored, or lacking enthusiasm, typically after having had too much of something. (थका हुआ)
 
 
• **Example: **After years of working long hours, he felt **jaded** and needed a break.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **"fatigued"** is **"jaded"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Activated** (सक्रिय): To make something active or operative.

 
 
• **Example:** The alarm system was **activated** as soon as the intruder entered the building.
 
 
 
• **Beguiled** (मोहित): To charm or enchant someone, often in a deceptive way.
 
 
• **Example:** She was** beguiled** by his charming personality and good looks.
 
 
 
• **Unwearied** (अथक): Not tired or fatigued; showing no signs of weariness.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite the long journey, he remained **unwearied** and full of energy.
